case_title: KUKAPALLI MOHAN RAO v. STATE OF A.P.
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under Section 302 IPC and sentenced to life imprisonment
neutral_facts: The accused, a man, killed the victim, a man, during an altercation suspected to be related to an illicit relationship between the victim and the accused's wife. The accused used an axe as the weapon. The victim sustained head injuries and later died from shock and head trauma. The accused was found by the victim's wife and brother-in-law at the scene with the axe, which was later recovered by the police. The victim's family took him to a private hospital where he was declared dead. The police registered a First Information Report (FIR) ten hours after the incident. The prosecution relied on eyewitness accounts, the recovered weapon, and medical evidence to establish the accused's guilt.
